title: imas
description: imas.es I-Mas Informatica S.L. is a Spanish IT services company founded in 2002 in Sabadell, Barcelona, specializing in custom software development, cloud solutions, ERP implementation, cybersecurity and managed IT services. With 50 to 120 employees and estimated revenue of 3 to 8 million euro, it serves small and medium businesses, industrial companies and public sector clients across Catalonia and Spain. Its technology stack includes SAP, Odoo, Microsoft Dynamics, AWS, Azure, React, Java and Python. Services span web and mobile development, cloud migration, business intelligence, network management and VoIP telephony. The company positions itself as a full-service technology partner for businesses in the Vallès Occidental region and beyond. Its 24-year track record covers manufacturing, retail, healthcare, education and logistics sectors.
